title: As long as you practise
goal: Set conditions with -DIğI sürece (as long as) and -mAdIkçA (unless).

intro.text: A bağlama teacher and her students: *Her gün çalıştığın sürece öğrenirsin* (as long as you practise every day, you'll learn), but *çalışmadıkça ilerleyemezsin* (unless you practise, you won't get anywhere). `-DIğI sürece` takes a possessive; `-mAdIkçA` never does.

vocab.en: bağlama, the long-necked Turkish lute (also called saz)
saz (another name for the bağlama); folk instrument
to make progress; to move forward
to go on stage, to perform

exercises.question: Complete: *Her gün çalış___ sürece bağlamayı öğrenirsin.* (As long as you practise every day, you'll learn the bağlama.)

why.1: *Çalıştıkça* is **the more you practise**, and it never takes *sürece*.

exercises.label: *çalışmak* + *sürece*: as long as I practise, you practise…

exercises.explain: The D of `-DIk` becomes t after ş, and k softens to ğ before a vowel: *çalış-tığ-ım*; *onlar* takes *-ları*: *çalıştıkları*.

why.2: *Söylemeden … bilmedi* is about the past: **nobody knew before you told**.

context.tr: Hocam, bağlamayı bir yılda öğrenebilir miyim?
context.en: Can I learn the bağlama in a year?

context.tr: Düzenli çalıştığın müddetçe öğrenirsin, merak etme.
context.en: As long as you practise regularly, you'll learn, don't worry.

exercises.question: What condition does the teacher set?
exercises.explain: *Düzenli çalıştığın müddetçe*: **as long as you practise regularly**. *Müddetçe* is a more formal *sürece*.

exercises.en: As long as you practise every day, you'll make progress.
